thread:
alex: incident-bot just paged P1: high-latency on embeddings in eu-west-1 — looks like spike on inference-mesh. incident-bot: INCIDENT 4589 | P1 | embeddings-euw1 | latency > 1200ms for 5m

sre-bot: automated mitigation kicked: autoscale attempt started, no pods available to scale in region (quota).

maria: I'm coming online for my shift in ~3m. who is currently driving?

alex: jordan started triage 6m ago, then had to step away for an urgent meeting. i paged for handoff but didn't get a confirmation. jordan — are you still on this?

jordan: sorry — on a call, just saw messages. i started checking router logs and KV-cache thrash, but didn't lock it down. handing off now if someone can take driver.

maria: ok i can take driver. alex — can you be comms until i fully catch up? i need runbook pointer for embeddings latency.

alex: yes i'll be comms. runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/embeddings_latency (shortlink in workspace). key checklist: 1) confirm affected hosts 2) check autoscaler events 3) verify model-variant fallback triggers 4) notify CS if >10m.

leo: FYI there's a known quota issue in euw1 for dedicated pools — eng-infra pinged infra-owner yesterday. might block autoscale.

maria: running these commands now:
```bash
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=embeddings -o wide
kubectl -n inference describe hpa embeddings-euw1
kubectl -n infra logs deploy/router --since=15m | grep "kv-cache" -i
```

maria: pods show 2/6 ready, rest are CrashLoopBackOff with OOM. images show v1.12. fallback variant-enabled for this customer.

alex: copying customers: onboarding@acme.example.com and PM path — @ops-bot can you trigger customer-notify template for impacted accounts?

ops-bot: /customer_notify triggered — template "latency_investigating" queued for: onboarding@acme.example.com. ETA to send 30s.

jordan: i'm going to attach core dumps to S3 for infra team: s3://redwood-incident/4589/cores/ — tagging infra-oncall.

maria: mitigation plan: 1) scale down model replica memory (temporary) 2) shift traffic to variant-b (lower perf but stable) 3) restart failing pods with image rollback if crash persists. i'll start shift-traffic now to variant-b.

alex: please post short status updates every 5 min. comms owner should also update incident doc and set Slack status. alex: setting channel topic to "P1 embeddings-euw1 — maria driving, alex comms" :rotating_light:

maria: traffic reroute command executed:
```bash
curl -X POST https://router.internal.redwood/api/route -d '{"service":"embeddings","variant":"b","percent":60}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER_TOKEN'
```

maria: traffic 60% shifted, latency for variant-b is ~350ms. overall 90th dropped from 1.2s -> 520ms. still seeing pod restarts.

alex: good. comms: i'm updating incident doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/incidents/4589 — noting handoff: jordan -> maria at 3315550120.

jordan: leaving reminder: if autoscale fails due to quota, we escalate to infra lead and request burst capacity via cloud console (ticket template on runbook).

leo: infra acknowledges and is requesting a quota increase; ETA 18m. filing infra ticket now.

maria: next action: rollback to image v1.11 on the CrashLoop pods to see if memory leak is introduced in v1.12. applying rollout now.

alex: timeline so far: incident opened 3315550000, jordan initial triage 3315549960, handoff to maria 3315550120. comms = alex until 3315550600 (est). if anyone needs to take comms when i go offline, call it out now.

ops-bot: customer_notify sent to onboarding@acme.example.com and platform-alerts@partners.

maria: rollback applied, restarting pods. watching logs.

maria: pods coming up stable, memory metric trending back to baseline. i'll keep driving until infra confirms quota or we fully stabilize.

alex: thanks team. quick handoff checklist note for future: when handoff happens during active P1, clearly declare "driver" and "comms" in first message, post runbook link, and set channel topic. makes a huge difference. :thumbsup:

jordan: noted. i also added a short snippet to the runbook about declaring comms/driver during transfer. will PR.

leo: infra ticket created (#INC-8245) — if quota not approved in 20m, we'll keep variant shift until TTL 60m.

maria: marking myself primary driver in incident doc, alex remaining comms for now. i'll post final update once all pods stable for 10m.

alex: signing off comms in 15m, will handover to leo if still active. thanks everyone. :handshake:
